headline: House Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries to be the next Speaker
summary: House Democrats voted on Wednesday 18 November to nominate their leader, Hakeem Jeffries of New York, as Speaker of the House. The full House will vote when the new Congress meets on 3 January.
why: If elected, Jeffries would be the first Black Speaker in US history. The Speaker controls which bills reach the House floor.

event.t: Democrats backed Jeffries by 251 votes to 11 in a closed-door meeting, CBS News reports.
The vote starts the formal process. The final choice is made by the whole House at the start of the new Congress.

effects.label: House leadership
effects.t: Jeffries is on track to lead the House from January.
